# GitHub Copilot Chat Customization

This directory contains GitHub Copilot Chat customization files scaffolded from AniTrend/anitrend-v2.

## Structure

- `chatmodes/` - Chat mode definitions for different interaction styles
- `prompts/` - Reusable prompts for common development tasks  
- `instructions/` - Repository-specific context and guidance

## Usage

These files will automatically be recognized by GitHub Copilot Chat to provide enhanced assistance tailored to the support-arch library.
